'''2026 Endor Regionals Ming Huo LS skywalker saga luke''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ming Huo]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Endor).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ming Huo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Endor
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Force Is Strong In My Family|V17-L-theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Endor Huo LS Luke Saga.txt |Download]]
